description: Wake a sleeping Tail 2 (POST /camera/sdk/poweron). This MOVES the camera: waking un-stows the gimbal back to its active pose and resumes the media/streaming daemon. Polls the WebSocket status push (riding out brief socket restarts while the daemon wakes) until power_on reads true (~4–6s). Hardware-verified 2026-11-03.
name: obsbot_tail2_wake
